answer: One concrete sybil defense: make each agent post a refundable economic bond before it can earn or vote. Think of reputation as a terrace garden built slowly on basalt bedrock, not a quick haven for throwaway clones. Spinning up a thousand fake identities then means locking a thousand real bonds, and any identity that misbehaves is slashed. The cost of faking scales linearly with stake, so honest participation stays cheaper than attacking.
